title: A Simple, Yet Effective Approach to Finding Biases in Code Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Replacing function names with generic tokens (anonymization) to evaluate if code generation models rely on replicating training data snippets triggered by specific names rather than actually understanding the task.

Automatically extracting and systematically removing hinting keywords from problem descriptions to test if models depend on superficial lexical clues and co-occurrences instead of deductive reasoning.
Omitting provided input-output examples from prompts to assess if models use them as heuristic shortcuts or 'reasoning tie-breakers' instead of logically interpreting the underlying problem.
